title: Sail Sunset

services.name: Sail Sunset
services.desc: Sail past the Statue of Liberty, sip under the Brooklyn Bridge, and watch the sunset paint the NYC skyline-all in one afternoon. Private charters for groups who want to escape the crowds and heat without the airport hassle. Our guests call it a mini-vacation without leaving the city. At Tribeca Sailing, we understand that no one wishes to sail in dangerous weather. The captain of the vessel has sole discretion to cancel a charter due to inclement weather. Examples of inclement weather include thunderstorms, lightning, excessive or dangerous winds, and sustained heavy rain. Most of our guests have a wonderful time even when conditions are not perfect. Your charter will proceed in light rain,

blurb: Sail Sunset offers private sailing charters departing from Pier 25, Manhattan. The captain has sole discretion to cancel charters due to inclement weather or safety concerns. Guests can reschedule once with a fee or purchase cancellation protection for refunds.
extraNote: Captain has sole discretion to cancel charters due to inclement weather or safety concerns. · If company cancels, guests get one-time reschedule or credit; no cash refunds. · All bookings are final and non-refundable except with 48-Hour Cancellation Protection purchased for 20% extra. · Guests may reschedule once with 48 hours notice and $300 fee; no rescheduling within 48 hours. · Guests who arrive late or no-show forfeit booking with no refund or rescheduling. · Strongly recommend travel insurance for trip cancellation and interruption. · Pier 25, Manhattan
